title: Checking an IOCTL's input
description:
Validate every field of a request from user mode before using it.

```
size 16, version 1, count 3    -> ok
size 8 (too small)              -> STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL
version 9                       -> STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED
count 1000000 (over the limit)  -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
```
hints: `if (length < sizeof(SetFilter)) return STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL;` then `std::memcpy(&local, buffer, sizeof local);` (lesson 2.05).
`if (local.flags & ~knownFlags)` catches bits you have not defined.
requirements: The request is `struct SetFilter { std::uint32_t size; std::uint32_t version; std::uint32_t count; std::uint32_t flags; };`
Check the buffer length, then copy it into a local struct before checking fields (so it cannot change under you).
Check every field, including unknown flag bits.
stretch: Write a small fuzzer that calls `validate` with thousands of random buffers.
